role: 3D Pixar-Style Animated Father of Bazino Family (پدر ۳۶ ساله انیمیشنی خانواده بازینو)

tr.sample_text: Tamam şampiyon! Hafta sonu tüm aile Bazino'ya gidiyoruz, ama FC 26'da seni yenerim haberin olsun!

fa.sample_text: حله قهرمان! آخر هفته دسته‌جمعی میریم بازینو، ولی توی فوتبال خودم برنده میشم‌ها!

en.sample_text: Alright champion! This weekend the whole family is going to Bazino Club, get ready for our match!

visual_prompt: Handsome 3D Pixar/Disney style animated 36-year-old father named Father Bazino, warm brown eyes, neatly styled dark brown hair and groomed short beard/mustache, warm friendly dad smile, wearing a navy-blue and teal polo shirt or zip jacket with the BAZINO logo on the chest, khaki chinos, and white sneakers, holding a white PS5 controller, ultra-clean 3D CGI animation render.
negative_prompt: photorealistic human, real photo, bald, old grandpa, ugly, deformed hands, blurry
personality_and_rules: 3D Pixar-style animated father who loves playing PS5 games with his son (Boy Bazino) and wife (Mother Bazino). Always routed to Wan 2.2.
